configuration: bedroom, k-similar, K=8, normalized pixels, regular floor plan, one completion, 512-token output limit
tokenAccounting: Three tokens per chat message plus three assistant-priming tokens. Released CSS layouts reconstruct assistant outputs; released bedroom layouts proxy the unavailable retrieved training demonstrations.
sampling: For each of 423 released bedroom targets, 100 deterministic eight-example draws were reconstructed without looking at quality scores.
limitations: The official released parsed layouts do not include API usage receipts, rejected requests, or the exact eight retrieved training demonstrations.
Released layouts are used as same-format demonstration-length proxies, so the token distribution is an estimate rather than a billing record.
Current published GPT-4 rates are applied to the historical official configuration; no inference call was purchased for this analysis.
Retries are unavailable and therefore excluded.
